description: This file contains utility functions for GST validation, address handling, tax calculations, and e-Way Bill generation specific to the Indian region within the ERPNext system.

methods.name: validate_gstin_for_india
methods.description: Validates the GSTIN of a document for India, including format and check digit.

methods.name: validate_pan_for_india
methods.description: Validates the PAN number format for India.

methods.name: validate_tax_category
methods.description: Checks for duplicate intra-state or inter-state tax categories for a given GST state.

methods.name: update_gst_category
methods.description: Updates GST category for linked Customer or Supplier records.

methods.name: set_gst_state_and_state_number
methods.description: Sets GST state and state number based on the address or state field.

methods.name: validate_gstin_check_digit
methods.description: Validates the check digit of a GSTIN.

methods.name: get_itemised_tax_breakup_header
methods.description: Returns header labels for itemized tax breakup, considering HSN/SAC settings.

methods.name: get_itemised_tax_breakup_data
methods.description: Generates itemized tax breakup data, optionally HSN-wise.

methods.name: set_place_of_supply
methods.description: Sets the place of supply based on address details.

methods.name: validate_document_name
methods.description: Validates the GST invoice/document number format and length.

methods.name: get_place_of_supply
methods.description: Determines the place of supply from address details.

methods.name: get_regional_address_details
methods.description: Fetches and updates regional address details, taxes, and supply info.

methods.name: get_item_list
methods.description: Prepares item list with tax details for GST reporting.

methods.name: validate_doc
methods.description: Validates if a document is eligible for E-Way Bill generation.

methods.name: get_transport_details
methods.description: Fetches and validates transport-related details for E-Way Bill.

methods.name: validate_pincode
methods.description: Validates the format and existence of a pincode.

methods.name: validate_state_code
methods.description: Validates and returns the GST state code.

methods.name: get_gst_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves GST account mappings based on company and charge type.

methods.name: validate_reverse_charge_transaction
methods.description: Ensures reverse charge GST transactions are correctly configured.

methods.name: update_itc_availed_fields
methods.description: Updates Input Tax Credit (ITC) fields based on GST taxes.

methods.name: update_place_of_supply
methods.description: Updates the place of supply based on customer address.

methods.name: get_regional_round_off_accounts
methods.description: Fetches GST accounts for round-off calculations.

methods.name: update_taxable_values
methods.description: Calculates and updates taxable values for items based on GST taxes.

methods.name: get_depreciation_amount
methods.description: Calculates depreciation amount based on method and asset details.

methods.name: set_item_tax_from_hsn_code
methods.description: Sets item taxes based on HSN code.

methods.name: delete_gst_settings_for_company
methods.description: Removes GST account settings for a specific company.

methods.name: get_gstins_for_company
methods.description: Fetches GSTINs linked to a company.

methods.name: get_address_details
methods.description: Gathers address details for E-Way Bill data.

methods.name: get_ewb_data
methods.description: Generates E-Way Bill JSON data for given documents.

methods.name: generate_ewb_json
methods.description: API to generate E-Way Bill JSON from document list.

methods.name: download_ewb_json
methods.description: API to download E-Way Bill JSON data as a file.
